story.titleZh: 阿隆索与阿斯顿·马丁近期怪象背后的技术谜团
story.summaryZh: The Race分析阿斯顿·马丁-本田近期成绩起伏中阿隆索遭遇的奇怪技术故障与退赛，并提到他在巴库用上了本田先给斯特罗尔在马德里使用的秘密ADUO 2涡轮升级。
story.originalTitle: The strange Alonso subplot to Aston Martin's weird recent run
story.summaryEn: The Race examines the strange technical problems and retirements Fernando Alonso has suffered amid Aston Martin-Honda's fluctuating form, and notes that in Baku he got the secret ADUO 2 turbocharger upgrade Honda first fitted to Lance Stroll's car in Madrid.
detailZh: 阿斯顿·马丁-本田近期的状态起伏不定，仿佛在模仿我们预期在2026年F1中看到的比赛风格，而其明星车手费尔南多·阿隆索身上还发生了一些更奇怪的事情。
我说的不是他与车队旷日持久、最近当然已经结束的合同谈判，而更多是他在本赛季可以说是围场里最麻烦的赛车上遇到的奇怪技术故障和退赛。
在巴库，阿隆索拿到了本田秘密的ADUO 2涡轮增压器升级，该升级此前先装在了兰斯·斯特罗尔于马德里驾驶的赛车上。
自本田在赞德沃特带来赛季中期的ADUO 1引擎升级以来，本田一直在努力改善驾驶性和涡轮迟滞，本田知道巴库将是检验这些特性的重要测试。
马克·休斯：这些惊人的数据暗示阿斯顿·马丁具备争夺杆位的潜力
减少涡轮迟滞不仅能改善发动机的整体驾驶性，还有助于防止MGU-K去填补因涡轮迟滞造成的发动机扭矩需求缺口，即电机本质上是用电池提供的电力来替代缺失的内燃机扭矩输出。
大量短促、缓慢的弯角以及困难且关键的牵引力区域，是检验你的赛车和发动机能否以正确方式出弯加速的良好测试。
在阿塞拜疆，更新后的阿斯顿·马丁——得益于车尾一些更轻的部件，比以往任何时候都更接近重量限制，再加上那台（我们认为）配备更小涡轮的规格2本田发动机——一直到城堡路段（含）都表现良好。
但随后它在第三赛段损失了大量圈速，这表明MGU-K在单圈早期做了太多那种“填补”（infilling），从而在之后造成了能量部署问题。
这是这辆车排位赛表现中的一个趋势，至少可以追溯到7月底在匈牙利B版赛车首次亮相时。单圈内圈速有明显退化，尤其是在该圈接近尾声时，几乎无论赛道如何都是如此。
在马来西亚甚至也是如此——那显然是这辆车本赛季的最佳表现——那里粗糙的赛道表面和过热的轮胎剥夺了所有赛车的抓地力，并人为地延长了慢弯和松油时段的长度与持续时间，而阿斯顿·马丁在这些地方相对更有竞争力。
回到巴库，阿隆索在阿塞拜疆大奖赛跑了20圈后退赛，显然是因为引擎问题。
“我没有看到任何警报，”他事后说道。“但我在直道上开始损失很多时间。你知道，大概1.5秒，所以肯定有问题。”
但赛后，本田检查了引擎，没有发现任何问题。
“目前引擎没有问题，我们在数据上没有发现任何异常，”本田首席赛道工程师折原慎太郎在那场比赛后说道。
“所以我们需要仔细检查引擎动力以及能量管理，也许还有GPS轨迹。”
随后，The Race 在下一站雪邦站询问本田，工厂的分析是否发现了任何问题，但本田再次表示没有发现任何异常。
“我们做了维护，并对引擎进行了物理检查，”折原说道。“但数据上仍然没有任何引擎问题的迹象。”
类似的事情也发生在新加坡。在又一次止步于第一节排位赛后，阿隆索声称他的赛车涡轮增压器“坏了”。因此，车队选择让他从维修区起步并换上全新部件，但本田再次未能在引擎上找到除阿隆索的诊断之外的任何涡轮问题证据。
本田在这里的脱困之道，是将车手——在此即阿隆索——描述为赛车内的“最佳传感器”，尤其当这个传感器拥有阿隆索那种不可思议的感知力和经验时更是如此。
同样属实的是，车手有时能察觉到工程师最初未能发现的问题——前威廉姆斯技术总监帕特里克·海德提供了一个很好的例子，他在2005年表示，车队新签下的尼克·海德菲尔德发现了宝马发动机管理系统的问题，而车队“已经带着这个问题两年了，却没有人指出来”。
那是20多年前的事了，在此期间F1数据采集的保真度已大幅提升，但这很好地说明了海德菲尔德作为车手特有的敏感度如何揭示了一个问题，而胡安·巴勃罗·蒙托亚或拉尔夫·舒马赫——两人在客观上都比海德菲尔德当时更成功——要么自己从未感觉到，要么没有受到足够严重的影响，以至于觉得有必要在汇报中提出。
阿隆索在座舱内作为精准的工程参考享有极高声誉，因此如果他察觉到问题，通常你会预期阿隆索感觉到的任何异常最终都会出现在本田的数据中。
在阿隆索的案例中，这（还）没有发生，而他在阿塞拜疆与通常较慢的凯迪拉克车手瓦尔特利·博塔斯缠斗时愤怒的车队无线电，清楚地表明他对那个周末本田发动机的整体性能并不满意。
阿斯顿·马丁车队现场负责人（兼前车队领队）迈克·克拉克随后提出，也许是跟随凯迪拉克时产生的尾流效应，再加上超车模式激活后带来的额外动力提升，可能让阿隆索感觉他的本田引擎出了问题。
这也有可能——阿隆索感觉到了一个实际上并不存在的问题。
也许永远没人能确定，但在本田从其遥测数据中发现尚未察觉的异常之前，所有迹象都指向阿隆索基本上是在巴库站放弃比赛、提前收工。
而且，考虑到车队在2026年的整体糟糕表现，也许没人能怪他！
detailEn: While Aston Martin-Honda's recent form has yo-yo'd, mimicking the style of racing we've come to expect in Formula 1 in 2026, there's been some even stranger things going on with its star driver Fernando Alonso.

I'm not talking about his protracted contract negotiations with the team, recently concluded of course, but more some of the strange technical problems and retirements he's had with what, to be fair, has been the most troublesome car on the grid this season.
In Baku, Alonso got his hands on the secret ADUO 2 turbocharger upgrade Honda fitted first to Lance Stroll's car in Madrid.
Honda's been trying to improve driveability and turbo lag since it brought its mid-season ADUO 1 engine upgrade to Zandvoort, and Honda knew Baku would be an important test for those characteristics.
Mark Hughes: The extraordinary figures hinting at Aston Martin's pole potential

Reduced turbo lag not only improves the overall driveability of the engine, it also helps prevent the MGU-K filling in the engine torque demand gaps created by that lag, whereby the motor essentially replaces missing internal combustion torque delivery with electrical power from the battery.
Lots of short, slow turns with difficult and crucial traction zones are a good test of whether your car and engine are punching off the corners in the right way.

In Azerbaijan, the updated Aston Martin - closer than ever to the weight limit thanks to some lighter components at the rear of the car, plus that spec-2 Honda engine with its (we think) smaller turbo - was working well up to and including the castle section.
But then it was haemorrhaging laptime through sector three, suggesting the MGU-K was doing too much of that 'infilling' early in the lap and then creating energy deployment problems later on.

This is a trend in the car's qualifying performances going back at least as far as the debut of the B-spec car in Hungary, in late July. There is a noticeable degradation in laptime over a single lap, particularly towards the end of that lap, almost regardless of the circuit.

This was even the case in Malaysia - easily that car's best performance of the season - where the rough track surface and overheating tyres robbed all the cars of grip and artificially extended the length and duration of the slow corners and off-throttle moments where the Aston Martin is relatively more competitive.
Returning to Baku, there Alonso retired from the Azerbaijan Grand Prix after 20 laps, apparently with an engine problem.
"I didn't see any alarm," he said afterwards. "But I started losing a lot on the straight. You know, like 1.5 seconds, so something wrong."
But after the race, Honda checked the engine and could find nothing wrong.
"At the moment the engine is OK, we don't find any issue on the data," said Honda chief trackside engineer Shintaro Orihara after that race.
"So we need to check carefully on the engine power and also energy management and also maybe GPS trace."
The Race then asked Honda at the next event in Sepang whether analysis at the factory had revealed any issue, but again Honda said it found nothing amiss.
"We did maintenance and we checked the engine physically," said Orihara. "But still on the data there is no indication of the engine problem."

Something similar happened in Singapore. After yet another Q1 exit, Alonso claimed his car's turbocharger was "broken". The team thus elected to start him from the pitlane with fresh components, but once again Honda could find no evidence of a turbo problem on the engine, beyond Alonso's diagnosis.

Honda's get out of jail card here has been to describe the driver - in this case Alonso - as "the best sensor" inside the car, especially so when that sensor has Alonso's incredible level of feel and experience.

It's also true that drivers sometimes detect problems that aren't initially picked up by engineers - there's a good example given by former Williams technical director Patrick Head, who back in 2005 said its new signing Nick Heidfeld had detected problems with the BMW engine's management system that the team had been "carrying for two years without anyone pointing it out".

That was more than 20 years ago, and the fidelity of data capture in F1 has improved vastly in that time, but it's a good example of how Heidfeld's particular sensitivity as a driver uncovered something problematic that Juan Pablo Montoya or Ralf Schumacher - both objectively more successful F1 drivers then Heidfeld was - either never felt themselves, or were not so unduly affected by to feel the need to raise in debriefs.

Alonso has an incredible reputation for being an accurate engineering reference inside the cockpit, and so if he's detecting an issue you would ordinarily expect whatever Alonso has felt going wrong to show up in Honda's data eventually.

That has't happened (yet) in Alonso's case, and his furious team radio while battling the usually slower Cadillac of Valtteri Bottas in Azerbaijan gave a clear indication he was less than happy with his Honda engine's overall performance that weekend.

Aston Martin trackside chief (and former team principal) Mike Krack later suggested perhaps the tow effect from following the Cadillac, combined with having the extra boost available from overtake mode being active, might have caused Alonso to feel as though there was a problem with his Honda engine.
That could also be possible - that Alonso has felt a problem that doesn't actually present itself in reality.

Perhaps no one will ever know for sure but, until Honda finds something it's yet to spot in its telemetry, all the signs point to Alonso basically throwing in the towel and taking an early bath in Baku.
And, given the team's woeful overall performance in 2026, maybe no one could blame him!
keyPointsZh: 本田自赞德沃特带来赛季中期ADUO 1引擎升级后，一直在改善驾驶性与涡轮迟滞，并认为巴库是检验这些特性的重要测试。
涡轮迟滞减小不仅改善引擎整体驾驶性，也有助于避免MGU-K用电池电能填补内燃机扭矩输出缺口。
keyPointsEn: Since bringing its mid-season ADUO 1 engine upgrade to Zandvoort, Honda has been working on driveability and turbo lag, and saw Baku as an important test of those characteristics.
Reduced turbo lag not only improves overall engine driveability but also helps prevent the MGU-K from filling the internal combustion torque gaps with battery power.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
